prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, healthy natural skin with real texture, not airbrushed, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: Ji Ran, a fictional 27-year-old, heroine; owner of Jiejian Company, an architecture and interior design firm; daughter of Ji Hongyuan; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: Strikingly beautiful East Asian woman in her late twenties who looks young and fresh. She has a small oval face with high cheekbones, a delicate tapered jaw and a fine straight nose. Her almond eyes are bright, intelligent and self-possessed under defined, softly arched brows with long lashes. Her complexion is flawless, luminous and even, with no redness and with natural skin texture. She wears full glamorous make-up with a glossy nude-rose lip. Her hair is long, glossy and jet black, falling to mid-back in sleek loose waves with a soft side part. She is tall at about 175 cm and about eight heads tall, with a small face, long legs and elegant supermodel proportions. Her figure is curvy: full C-to-D-cup bust, defined waist, full hips, hourglass shape. Accessories are small diamond stud earrings and a slim gold bracelet watch. In the flashback at 22 she has the same face, slightly softer and fuller-cheeked, with her hair long and straight.. Wearing one outfit only: Office, day one: a fitted dove-grey silk button-down shirt with long sleeves, tucked in, the top two buttons open. A black high-waisted bodycon pencil skirt to just above the knee, cinched at the waist with a thin black leather belt. Black pointed-toe stiletto pumps.. Signature colour: black. In the close-up a calm, attractive expression with bright, intelligent eyes and only a hint of: Cool, sharp-tongued and fiercely self-possessed. She is wounded by her father treating her as a bargaining chip and by Lu Shaoze leaving five years ago. She refuses to be arranged ever again and wants to choose her own man, efficiently and on her own terms. Under the ice she has a dry, playful sense of humour.; no tears. The full-body views keep the body's build and proportions as the appearance gives them, head-to-body ratio included, never slimmer. Cast as a commercial live-action short drama: an adult lead (the heroine, the hero) or a young adult woman in a prominent role is a strikingly beautiful or handsome, camera-ready actor, with the figure, make-up, hair and fitted outfit the appearance and outfit give; a character under 18 looks and dresses like an ordinary child or teenager of that age and is never styled to look sexy; any other supporting role is an ordinary-looking person of that age.
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 27, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
